stem.text: Which compound is a secondary alcohol that can be dehydrated to form an alkene with $M_\text{r} = 70$?

A.alt: Skeletal formula of an alcohol with the OH group drawn below a carbon atom, option A.

B.alt: Skeletal formula of an alcohol with the OH group drawn below a carbon atom, option B.

C.alt: Skeletal formula of an alcohol with the OH group drawn below a carbon atom, option C.

D.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclic alcohol: a cyclopentane ring with an OH group on one ring carbon.
